description: In crates/core/src/audit.rs, 'as_millis() as i64' uses a Rust as-cast that silently truncates on overflow. The idiomatic pattern for fallible numeric narrowing in this codebase is i64::try_from(...).map_err(...) — see sqlite_storage.rs lines 39-44 for the established pattern. Replace the as-cast with try_from and propagate as a StorageError::Database to keep error handling consistent.
title: audit: as_millis() as i64 should use try_from, not as-cast
